The '''T-47 sandspeeder''' was a variant of the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeder]] utilized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in desert conditions during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Arda I" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:VortexSquadron-OaAI.png|thumb|left|250px|Vortex Squadron was made up of T-47 Sandspeeders.]]
Like the base model, the speeder had a crew of 1 [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and 1 [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]], although it replaced the [[Power harpoon launcher]] with a rear-mounted [[T-21 light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blaster cannon]]. The speeder had a max flight ceiling of 175 meters. The armor was also reduced in favor of increased maneuverability, and was painted a camouflaging reddish-orange.<ref name="Arda I" /> It was modified specifically to undergo operations in hot, dry conditions. The drive section was left exposed for easier maintenance, although the airspeeder itself was enclosed. It also had a maximum speed of 600 kilometers per hour.<ref name="CCG" />

Specific modifications made to the sandspeeder included advanced filters designed to prevent the build-up of sand in the craft's [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and steering flaps, cooling systems for the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] and engines, and a long-range [[Radar/Legends|radar]] for navigation in [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorms]].<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

They had been developed shortly after the Alliance had modified the T-47 airspeeder to operate on Hoth, leaving the modifications of the same airspeeder for arid environments relatively simple.<ref name="SS Titan">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Titanium Series|pack=Sandspeeder|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/SW08TSsandspeeder.asp}}</ref> The Rebel [[Arda Base|base]] on [[Arda I]] used [[Vortex Squadron (Arda I)|Vortex Squadron]] consisting of sandspeeders for patrolling [[The Gauntlet (Arda I)|the Gauntlet]] canyon.<ref name="Arda I" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Sandspeeder_-_The_Epic_Continues.jpg|thumb|250px|Kenner's Sandspeeder toy prototype]]
The Sandspeeder was planned to be implemented into [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] ''[[The Epic Continues]]'' storyline, but the toy line was ultimately rejected. It was included in a binder containing several images of planned toys within ''The Epic Continues''<ref name="Binder">{{WebCite|url=http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=50986|text=1985-86 Line Extension Presentation Binder Page 28 - Rebel Armored Sandspeeder|work=The Star Wars Collectors Archive|archivedate=20210413132009}}</ref>, some of which later appeared in the article [[Galactic Bazaar|''Tales of Phantom Toys'']] in ''[[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine]]''<ref name="Tales">{{GalaxyCite|2|Galactic Bazaar|Galactic Bazaar: Tales of Phantom Toys}}</ref>. It eventually appeared in canon with the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' from [[West End Games]].<ref name="RPG 2nd">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref>
